verdict.rationale: ClickUp's Brain² is described as checking the workspace, apps, and web for answers and pulling from integrations like Google Drive and GitHub, which implies broad search-like retrieval, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated fast/accurate full-text search across tasks, docs, and comments, nor any benchmark or independent validation of search speed/accuracy. General community complaints about ClickUp being slow and bloated are not specific to search functionality, so they inform confidence rather than dispute the claim. Missing for 10: dedicated search feature documentation, explicit mention of searching comments, and independent verification of search speed/accuracy.
